## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed icon, illustration or graphic is a Higgsfield asset: prompt in `prompts.tsv` (or the folder's README), job id and credits in `higgsfield-jobs.tsv`, a LEGAL entry, drawn through `crate::icons` or `crate::art`. No emoji, Unicode symbols or painter-drawn shapes as icons (`tools/check_icons.py` runs in CI).
- [ ] No keys, tokens or private paths in the diff.
